question:
{image}The paper this image came from examines the dispersion and local concentration of indium within zeolite frameworks following high-temperature thermal treatments in air.

What is a caption that is suitable for this image?
answer: (a) SEM micrograph displaying clusters of particulate matter. Two circular regions, labeled 1 and 2, denote areas where localized elemental analysis was conducted. An associated text box provides the indium (In) weight percentages for the overall image (6.7 wt. %), Zone 1 (7.3 wt. %), and Zone 2 (12.9 wt. %). Scale bar: 5 µm. (b) SEM micrograph of a different sample region. A dashed rectangular frame indicates the area for mapping, and a circular region marks Zone 1. The indium weight percentages are reported as 7.5 wt. % for the general area and 17.8 wt. % for Zone 1. Scale bar: 10 µm. (c) Elemental map showing the spatial distribution of indium within the rectangular sector defined in (b), where brighter pixels represent higher concentrations of the element.
